item.title: Metro Detroit businesses split on staying open during anti-ICE protest
item.description: Some businesses chose to remain open during anti-ICE protests, offering what they described as safe spaces for their communities while others closed their doors in solidarity with the demonstrations.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan beats No. 7 Michigan State, takes sole possession of 1st place in Big Ten
item.description: Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 points and 12 rebounds, Elliot Cadeau scored 17 and Morez Johnson added 12 points to lead No. 3 Michigan to an victory over seventh-ranked Michigan State on Friday night.

item.title: 5-year-old girl drowns in pool in Oakland County, sheriff's office investigating
item.description: A 5-year-old girl from Sterling Heights drowned in a pool in Oakland County Friday evening, deputies say.
